items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 9:1
items.html: A light passing through a screen means, through a coupling of striking, in which the screen returns the light backward in the secret of reflected light. According to the measure of the coarseness in the screen, so is the measure of the level that the reflected light clothes, as is known. And the coupling made for the sake of creation was added with a new matter: that the screen is included in the Parsa between Atzilut and Beriah. Therefore this screen of phase two, upon which the aforementioned coupling of striking is made, became a screen separating upon the light of Hochma, and it clothes only Hassadim separated from Hochma. (Item 31).
